title: v4 node.generate payload pull descriptor and context bundle
description: Out-of-band context bundle pull descriptor carried on a contract_version 4 node.generate invoke request, plus the schema of the pulled context bundle itself ($defs/contextBundle). The invoke request never inlines raw context: the plugin fetches the context bundle once using the single-use access_token (TTL <= 600s) and a plugin-to-host-api directional HMAC signature.

delivery.description: Transport mode discriminator for node.generate context bundle pull.

mode.description: Alias transport discriminator compatible with v3 pull descriptors.

url.description: Host payload pull endpoint path or HTTPS URL for this execution_id.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the serialized context bundle.

media_type.description: Media type of the context bundle payload.

size_bytes.description: Optional byte length of the serialized context bundle.

access_token.description: Single-use JWT token (typ=ct-executor-payload+jwt, scope=executor:context_bundle:pull, TTL <= 600s) bound to execution_id and bundle_sha256.

jti.description: Optional single-use token identifier echoed for diagnostics.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC expiration timestamp of the single-use pull token.

ref_uri.description: Canonical source reference URI allowed for citation in the generated output.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity classification of the context item.

format.description: Expected output format for the node generation result.

schema.description: Strict JSON Schema when format is 'json_schema'.

input.description: Compiled Markdown prompt input including untrusted context envelopes.
